g.text: Scissors vs rock: the electrode-by-time patterns hidden by averaging
Rows: 60 electrodes kept separate. Columns: the exact eight 250 ms log-power features used by LDA.
A-B: orange = above the training mean; blue = below. C: orange = scissors higher; blue = rock higher.
Whitening; CV repeat 1, fold 8. Templates use training trials only (81 total, 27 per class). Colors are NOT pre-cue dB.
